beliefs: Each character is shifted by ASCII +1 (a→b, A→B, 0→1, space→!, ~→DEL) [E1, E5, E7]
After shifting, the first character of each maximal run of lowercase letters is uppercased; subsequent lowercase letters in the same run keep their raw +1 shift (already lowercase) [E12, E13, E10]
Uppercase letters, digits, spaces, and symbols get only the raw +1 shift with no case change (A→B, Z→[, 0→1) [E1, E2, E7, E11]
Runs are broken by any non-lowercase character, so 'aB'→'Bc' and 'Ba'→'Cb' [E12, E13]
When the first char of a lowercase run is 'z', its shifted result '{' is uppercased to '[' [E8, E11]
The uppercase step applies only to the first char of a lowercase run, so 'ab'→'Bc', 'aa'→'Bb', 'baa'→'Cbb' [E12, E13]
